🎉 Proud moment for Anandi! Reyaansh Dhagle, with team Techtile Twins, has qualified for the World Robot Olympiad European Open Championship in Zagreb, Croatia.

Their project, Echoes of Heritage, asks: who are the real protectors of our heritage? Their answer is empowered, self-sufficient communities. 

Brought to life by a robotic solution that scans India's ancient temple carvings, creates 3D models, reads their patterns via machine learning, and reprints them onto fabric using traditional block printing, helping communities preserve, celebrate, and monetize their culture.

Their journey this season has been remarkable:

🥇 1st, Virtual Round
🥇 1st, Regional Round
🏅 Gold Badge, Nationals
🌍 Now, Zagreb!

Competing against the finest young innovators from around the world, Reyaansh carries Anandi, Bengaluru, and India onto the world stage. All the best, Reyaansh! 🍀

A little news we’ve been excited to share. Anandi is coming to Gurgaon. 🌿

Our new home in DLF Phase 2 is taking shape, and we can’t wait to welcome our first Anandi families here.

We’re bringing our 4+1 Field Model to Gurgaon - 4 days of classroom learning and 1 day solving real-world problems with real-world mentors. 

Here’s a little glimpse of the campus. And if you’d like to get to know us better, come meet prachipawar9 , our Founder, and Caroline, our Principal, this weekend. We’d love to meet you. Reserve an appointment through link in bio.

If you know a family in Gurgaon who you think would love the Anandi way, please share this with them. ❤️
